task:
MAKE THE PRODUCTION VERSION-DRIFT MONITOR HONEST ABOUT AN INTENTIONAL PROMOTION HOLD. Start from origin/main (3b6ee91 or later). Context (verified): .github/workflows/prod-version-drift.yml runs scripts/checks/prod_version_drift.py every 6 hours and fails when production serves a build behind deployable commits on main by more than 12 hours. It passed every run from 2026-09-26 (after bed755b9 was promoted on 2026-09-25) to 2026-10-04 and has failed every run since 2026-10-05, 12 hours after PR #777 (F3) merged. That failure is CORRECT: production is intentionally held at bed755b944eb6cb226e1726b2a51582ba9fa9bdb because docs/operations/v3-production-application-release.md (section 'F3 Finder cutover — product-publish promotion gate') forbids promoting main until the Finder products are built and published (rollout steps in docs/ROADMAP.md). A monitor that fails four times a day for weeks trains the owner to ignore it. Implement an explicit, dated, reviewed hold that the monitor understands, without weakening any other check.

1. New file deploy/v3-production/promotion-hold.json with exactly these keys: schema_version 'ed-finder/production-promotion-hold/v1'; held_live_sha '<40-hex>' = bed755b944eb6cb226e1726b2a51582ba9fa9bdb; held_since '2026-10-04' (ISO date); expires_at '2026-11-09T00:00:00Z' (RFC3339 UTC); reason (one paragraph: F3 cutover must not be promoted before the Finder products publish; cite the release-gate section and the roadmap sequence); review (text; leave as 'this PR' and I will fill the number). No other keys.

2. scripts/checks/prod_version_drift.py: add --hold-file (default: deploy/v3-production/promotion-hold.json relative to --repo; absent file = no hold). Load it fail-closed: any missing/extra key, non-hex sha, unparsable dates, expires_at earlier than held_since, or hold longer than 45 days (expires_at - held_since) -> exit 3 'INVARIANT VIOLATION: promotion hold file invalid: <reason>'. Extend decide() with a hold parameter (keep every existing branch and message intact and in the same order): the web/API mismatch and hex invariants and the --expected-sha gate still run first and still fail; then, if a valid hold exists and api_sha == held_live_sha: if now < expires_at -> exit 0 with 'HELD: production intentionally at <sha> since <date> (<reason first 120 chars>); hold expires in <N> days; <k> deployable commit(s) waiting on main' (list them as the stale branch does); if now >= expires_at -> exit 1 'HOLD EXPIRED on <expires_at>: ...' followed by the normal stale analysis lines. If a hold exists but api_sha != held_live_sha, print one note 'NOTE: promotion hold for <sha> does not match live <sha>; ignored — remove or update the hold file' and continue with the normal logic. Print which hold file was used (or 'no hold file') in the output. Keep the module importable without the file.

3. .github/workflows/prod-version-drift.yml: pass --hold-file "deploy/v3-production/promotion-hold.json" explicitly; add a workflow_dispatch input ignore_hold (default 'false') that, when 'true', omits the flag so an operator can see the raw drift. No permission changes.

4. tests/test_prod_version_drift.py: add cases for every new branch: held within expiry -> 0 and message; expired -> 1; non-matching live sha -> hold ignored and normal result; mismatch invariant still wins over a hold; invalid hold file (each validation rule) -> 3; hold > 45 days -> 3; missing file -> no hold. Read tests/test_deploy_drift_contract.py and keep it passing; if it enumerates deploy/v3-production files or workflow text, extend it to cover the new file and flag.

5. Docs: add a short subsection to docs/operations/v3-production-application-release.md right after the F3 promotion-gate section: 'Promotion hold (version-drift monitor)': what the file is, that it is reviewed in a PR, that it expires and must be renewed or removed, and that it must be removed in the same PR that revises the release gate for the fresh generation (rollout step 10). Add a CHANGES.md entry in the house style.

FILES YOU MAY TOUCH: deploy/v3-production/promotion-hold.json (new), scripts/checks/prod_version_drift.py, .github/workflows/prod-version-drift.yml, tests/test_prod_version_drift.py, tests/test_deploy_drift_contract.py, docs/operations/v3-production-application-release.md, CHANGES.md. Nothing else.

VALIDATE and report: py_compile and ruff on the changed Python; python -m pytest tests/test_prod_version_drift.py tests/test_deploy_drift_contract.py -q; a local dry run of the script's decide() path via the tests (the live site is not reachable from the runner; do not claim a live check); git diff --name-only showing only allowed paths.
